row.name: file_versions_superseded_idx
row.where: superseded_at is not null and purged_at is null

row.name: drive_nodes_versions_valid
row.value: "key_epoch" >= 1 and "parent_key_epoch" >= 1 and "metadata_version" >= 1 and "height_bound" >= 0 and ("prev_parent_key_epoch" is null or "prev_parent_key_epoch" >= 1)

row.name: drive_nodes_envelopes_valid
row.value: ("purged_at" is not null and "key_envelope" is null and "metadata_envelope" is null and "prev_key_envelope" is null) or ("purged_at" is null and octet_length("key_envelope") = 72 and octet_length("metadata_envelope") between 42 and 4136)

row.name: drive_nodes_prev_envelope_valid
row.value: ("prev_key_envelope" is null) = ("prev_parent_key_epoch" is null) and ("prev_key_envelope" is null or octet_length("prev_key_envelope") = 72)

row.name: drive_objects_framing_valid
row.value: "content_suite" = 1 and "chunk_size" > 0 and "chunk_count" >= 1 and octet_length("content_nonce") = 16 and "plaintext_size" >= 0 and "ciphertext_size" = "plaintext_size" + 16 * "chunk_count"

row.name: drive_uploads_values_valid
row.value: "key_epoch" >= 1 and "reserved_bytes" >= 0 and ("status" <> 'completing' or "completing_at" is not null) and ("status" in ('aborted', 'completed') or "object_id" is not null)

row.name: file_versions_envelope_valid
row.value: ("status" = 'purged' and "content_key_envelope" is null and "purged_at" is not null) or ("status" <> 'purged' and octet_length("content_key_envelope") = 72 and "object_id" is not null)
